title: work in progress
author: tasthebrave
selftext: I am working on a coop tower defense game and it may still be a little while before I want to try to get a group together, but I'm looking to find 9 other people willing to help me playtest it and stress test with a full game of 10 players I am trying to gather people early so we can plan a time that works for everyone. Thank you for your time and consideration.

comments.author: HotAppleMaligaros
comments.body: Perhaps you posted this in the wrong place? Could you show some screenshots? I’m really curious to see what your game looks like.

replies.body: So to be honest im still working with placeholders until I get more or the gameplay loop nailed down it still off so im tweaking it but I do plan to post some pics and videos in the near future
